name: substack-agent
description: Automate Substack posts with AI-powered content generation — MCP server and tool-calling API for AI agents

scripts.build:landing: cd landing-page && npm run build && rm -f ../public/assets/index-* ../public/assets/DocsLayout-* ../public/assets/rolldown-runtime-* ../public/assets/lib-* ../public/assets/rehype-highlight-* ../public/assets/atom-one-dark-* && cp dist/index.html ../public/index.html && cp -f dist/favicon.svg dist/icons.svg ../public/ && cp -r dist/assets/* ../public/assets/
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run ci:static
